sql: SELECT TOP 1 p.StoreCode AS storeCode, p.PortalId AS portalId, MAX(f.widgetsKey) AS widgetKey, COUNT(f.sku) AS productCount, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos1 THEN f.sku END) AS product1Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos1 THEN f.productId END) AS product1Id, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos1 THEN f.name END) AS product1Name, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos1 THEN f.shownPrice END) AS product1ShownPrice, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos1 THEN f.cutPrice END) AS product1CutPrice, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos2 THEN f.sku END) AS product2Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos2 THEN f.productId END) AS product2Id, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos2 THEN f.name END) AS product2Name, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos2 THEN f.shownPrice END) AS product2ShownPrice, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos2 THEN f.cutPrice END) AS product2CutPrice, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos3 THEN f.sku END) AS product3Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos3 THEN f.productId END) AS product3Id, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos3 THEN f.name END) AS product3Name, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos3 THEN f.shownPrice END) AS product3ShownPrice, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos3 THEN f.cutPrice END) AS product3CutPrice, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos4 THEN f.sku END) AS product4Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos4 THEN f.productId END) AS product4Id, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos4 THEN f.name END) AS product4Name, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos4 THEN f.shownPrice END) AS product4ShownPrice, MAX(CASE WHEN f.position = @pos4 THEN f.cutPrice END) AS product4CutPrice FROM dbo.ZnodePortal p INNER JOIN (SELECT k.portalId, k.widgetsKey, k.sku, k.productId, k.name, k.shownPrice, k.cutPrice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k.portalId ORDER BY k.displayOrder, k.widgetRowId) AS position FROM (SELECT w.PortalId AS portalId, w.WidgetsKey AS widgetsKey, w.SKU AS sku, pr.productId AS productId, pr.name AS name, COALESCE(gp.SalesPrice, gp.RetailPrice) AS shownPrice, CASE WHEN gp.SalesPrice IS NOT NULL THEN gp.RetailPrice END AS cutPrice, w.DisplayOrder AS displayOrder, w.PublishWidgetProductEntityId AS widgetRowId, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.PortalId ORDER BY CHARINDEX(w.WidgetsKey, pp.PageJSON), w.WidgetsKey) AS widgetRank FROM dbo.ZnodePublishWidgetProductEntity w INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishWebstoreEntity ws ON ws.VersionId = w.VersionId AND ws.PortalId = w.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCMSPortalProfilePageMapper pm ON pm.PortalId = w.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCMSPortalPages pp ON pp.CMSPortalPageId = pm.CMSPortalPageId CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 pe.ZnodeProductId AS productId, pe.Name AS name FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity v ON v.VersionId = pe.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = pe.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE pe.SKU = w.SKU AND pc.PortalId = w.PortalId AND pe.LocaleId = @localeId AND pe.IsActive = @isActive AND v.RevisionType = @publishState AND v.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND v.LocaleId = @localeId ORDER BY pe.PublishProductEntityId DESC) pr OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 zp.RetailPrice, zp.SalesPrice FROM dbo.ZnodePrice zp INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList pl ON pl.PriceListId = zp.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal plo ON plo.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId WHERE zp.SKU = w.SKU AND plo.PortalId = w.PortalId AND (pl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (zp.ActivationDate IS NULL OR zp.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (zp.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR zp.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY plo.Precedence, pl.PriceListId, zp.PriceId) gp WHERE ws.PublishState = @publishState AND ws.LocaleId = @localeId AND w.TypeOFMapping = @portalMapping AND w.MappingId = w.PortalId AND pm.PageCode = @homePageCode AND pm.ProfileId IS NULL AND CHARINDEX(w.WidgetsKey, pp.PageJSON) > @zero) k WHERE k.widgetRank = @pos1) f ON f.portalId = p.PortalId WHERE p.StoreCode = @store GROUP BY p.PortalId, p.StoreCode HAVING (@minProducts IS NULL OR COUNT(f.sku) >= @minProducts) ORDER BY p.PortalId
